entries.purpose: A genuinely independent local inference provider (SINGLE_PROVIDER_DEPENDENCY resilience, Founder-authorized 2026-08-18) — a separate llama-server process, not dependent on the `ollama serve` daemon, used as a failover-of-last-resort when Ollama itself is unavailable. Fixed: threshold lowered to 600s (still generous relative to its ~90s restart cost), made configurable via MRSILENT_PROVIDER_B_IDLE_RECLAIM_S, and reclaim now has an EXPLICIT guard (has_active_generation(), self-healing marker files) against stopping mid-request — previously only an implicit timing coincidence.

entries.purpose: Live Sensor Input Architecture + Governance milestone (explicit Founder authorization, 2026-08-18: 'YES — MR. SILENT is authorized to eventually support live microphone and live camera input'). DISCOVERY FIRST: this server is a headless cloud droplet with NO physical audio/video capture hardware (confirmed: no /dev/video*, no ALSA capture devices, arecord/pactl/v4l2-ctl not installed) — 'live sensor input' therefore means RECEIVING chunked audio/video from an authorized client over the network, not local device access. Implements the Founder's own sensor-access law directly: EXPLICIT (a session exists only because a caller explicitly created one), PERMISSIONED (founder_approved=True required, no implicit grant), DEVICE-CONTROLLED (every session names its claimed client device_id), BOUNDED (auto-expires, default/max 300s, never open-ended), OBSERVABLE (every create/chunk/end/revoke durably audited), REVOCABLE (revoke_session()/revoke_all_sessions() — an immediate kill switch). The bridge layer routes reconstructed chunked recordings through the EXISTING, unmodified local_audio_transcription_v1 and local_video_analysis_v1 capabilities — no third analysis engine. REAL DEVICE SENSOR BRIDGE milestone (2026-08-18): the server-side API is now real and network-reachable. DISCOVERY found the Founder's own Android phone (amoss-s25-ultra) already enrolled on this Studio's Tailscale network, and Scorpio's Corner already uses `tailscale serve` to expose its own app_api securely (tailnet-only HTTPS, real TLS cert, no public internet exposure) — this milestone adds an ADDITIVE, separate tailscale serve mapping (port 8443, verified not to touch Scorpio's Corner's own 443/8780 mappings) for MR. SILENT's own live_sensor_api.py (a stdlib http.server, bound to 127.0.0.1 only, bearer-token authenticated, running under a new mrsilent-live-sensor-api.service systemd unit). A live browser client (live_sensor_client.html) is served at the same origin.

entries.health_status_method: n/a — stateless request/response; GET /health on the same service gives real-time liveness
entries.status: active — first vertical slice (text + voice conversation) proven live end-to-end, now backed by grounded natural-language conversation (not just a narrow deterministic parser), including a real synthetic-speech-to-real-transcript-to-real-answer round trip; NOT yet exercised on the Founder's real device Camera-in-conversation added 2026-08-19: explicit camera activation + Ask-about-camera action route real vision Q&A into the SAME conversation feed, with the answer remembered for later text follow-ups.

entries.name: Omni Device Lab
entries.purpose: Governed cross-platform certification fabric: installs/launches/exercises real builds on real emulators/VMs/browsers, captures bounded failure evidence, dispatches governed repair, and retests until certified or a genuine Founder/physical-device gate is hit.
entries.io_contract: in: build artifact path + device profile + test suite; out: durable CertificationRun JSON (status, steps, evidence_paths, repair_job_ids, final_status)
entries.working_scope: omni_device_lab_runtime/runs/<run_id>/ (durable evidence + run record); real AVDs under the existing Android SDK install; never touches production delivery routes directly
entries.cost_class: free (local emulator/VM compute only; no paid device-farm/cloud service)
entries.authority_requirements: none to run certification/evidence capture; founder approval required for any dispatched repair job exactly as omniengineer_harness.submit_job() already requires
entries.required_approvals: same as omniengineer_harness.submit_job() for any dispatched repair
entries.health_status_method: registry.list_runs() non-empty + adb/emulator binaries present on PATH
entries.validation_method: test_omni_device_lab.py known-bad/known-good fixture proof + real durable run records
